faqs.question: How long does a typical Meta Ads Management engagement take?
faqs.answer: Pixel/setup and first campaigns usually launch in 2–3 weeks, then creative testing compounds results over subsequent cycles.

faqs.question: Do you work with existing teams and tools?
faqs.answer: Yes. We work in your Meta Business Manager and coordinate creatives, offers, and CRM events with your team.

faqs.question: How do you measure success?
faqs.answer: CPA/CAC, ROAS, frequency health, creative fatigue signals, and downstream lead or purchase quality.

faqs.question: Prospecting and remarketing both?
faqs.answer: Yes. We design full-funnel structures with clean audiences, exclusions, and creative matched to awareness stage.

faqs.question: How important is creative?
faqs.answer: Critical. We run structured creative tests (hooks, angles, formats) because Meta rewards message-market fit more than micro-bidding tweaks alone.

faqs.question: Can you manage Instagram and Facebook together?
faqs.answer: Yes — placements are optimized within campaigns while brand safety and creative variants stay intentional.

faqs.question: What about iOS attribution gaps?
faqs.answer: We tighten events, use modeled conversions carefully, and triangulate with GA4/CRM so decisions are not blindly platform-optimistic.

faqs.question: Do you need product catalogs?
faqs.answer: For ecommerce DPA/Advantage+ shopping, catalogs help. We can audit feed health or start with non-catalog prospecting if needed.

faqs.question: How do we get started?
faqs.answer: Share Business Manager access, offers, and creative inventory. We audit tracking, then launch a focused test matrix.

faqs.question: Who produces creatives?
faqs.answer: We can brief your designers, produce iterations, or partner with our creative studio depending on bandwidth.
